subject: Gates 6-8 have no server-side completion path (blocks BUG-043 half B)
description:
functions/index.js:113-115 documents gates 6-8 as locally validated with proof optional; gate-6/7/8 write their localStorage flags directly with no CF write, so users/{uid}/gates/gate{6,7,8} never exists. This is why the reported vault exploit (full vault at Master rank) cannot be closed by hydration, and why a naive revoke would wipe real student progress. Needs: a server-side completion path for multi-step gates, then extend AccessGuard._verifyGateAsync/verifyGateAccess (which already implements trust-then-verify for gates <=5) to cover 1-8. Found by Nancy during the BUG-043 review.
[2026-07-29 00:23] CORRECTED 2026-07-28 (Chris): the premise was wrong. Gates 6-8 DO call completeGate (gate-6.html:1292, gate-7.html:1301, gate-8.html:1795) and it DOES write users/{uid}/gates/gateN; verifyGateAccess already loops 1..N with no cutoff at 5. The real blocker is BUG-044: completeGate validates proof only when proof is non-empty AND gate<=5, so any signed-in caller can forge completions for all gates in an ascending loop. Fix BUG-044 before any hydration work.
[2026-07-29 00:27] TITLE IS STALE -- read the correction note above it. Accurate title: 'Gates 6-8 server completion is unvalidated (completeGate rubber-stamp)'. The gates DO have a server path; it just does not verify the work.
[2026-07-31 10:51] VERIFIED RESOLVED 2026-07-31 by live measurement, not by reading source. (1) BUG-044 fix is DEPLOYED: called the production callable completeGate with gateNumber=9, proof='' using a signed-in QC account -> PERMISSION_DENIED 'This gate cannot be completed through this endpoint. Submit your answer to be validated.' That is the fail-closed CLIENT_ATTESTED_GATES=[6,7,8] allowlist from commit 177acbf3a answering in production, so the ascending-loop forgery is closed. (2) verifyGateAccess (functions/index.js:165+) loops 'for (let i = 1; i <= gateNum; i++)' with NO cutoff at 5, so gates 1-8 are already covered -- confirming Chris's 2026-07-28 correction. Nothing left to build. The task TITLE was always wrong (gates 6-8 DO have a server path); the accurate title was 'completeGate rubber-stamp', and that is fixed and live.
